# Pi Card v0.1.0 (draft)

> Draft only. Do not publish until npm package ownership/access, trusted publishing, and licensing are confirmed.

Pi Card adds explicit delivery timing for messages sent while Pi is working.

- Route plain text as a steer, stop/interrupt, or follow-up when Jev is enabled with `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.
- Keep exact control with `**` interrupt, `&&` follow-up, `??` brainstorm, and `~~` flip cards.
- Add optional user-labeled routing examples and time-gap debounce for combining closely spaced messages.
- Preserve native Pi input behavior when routing is unavailable; stop classification remains confidence-gated.

See the README for usage and configuration docs for privacy details. Jev classification sends eligible message text and configured examples to TypeSafe AI.

After the release exists, users can install through Pi's package manager (`pi install npm:@carbon-ni/pi-card`) or from the tagged source (`pi install git:github.com/carbon-ni/pi-card@v0.1.0`).
